latest_release.name: tailwind-merge@3.7.0
latest_release.body:
### New Features

- Prepare some upcoming changes by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/713
  - Theme getters returned by `fromTheme` now expose the theme key they read as a `themeKey` property, so tooling can identify the referenced theme scale without calling the getter.
  - Release tags now include the package name, starting with `tailwind-merge@3.7.0`.

### Bug Fixes

- Fix arbitrary values using `color()` or `light-dark()` being classified as lengths instead of colors by @ddussi in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/712
- Fix bare `bg-conic` not merging with other background image classes by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/708
- Fix `columns-auto` not conflicting with other `columns` classes by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/707
- Fix container sizes like `inline-2xl` not merging by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/706
- Fix `max-h-none` missing in max-h class group by @mutewinter in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/704
- Fix axis shorthands like `px` not overriding logical sides like `ps` by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/705
- Fix `leading-none` being removed when the leading theme scale is overridden by @chatman-media in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/689
- Fix deprecated `shadow-inner` being classified as shadow color instead of shadow by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/703

### Documentation

- Add Deno to install instructions by @bartlomieju in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/687
- Add missing `text-shadow` theme key to configuration docs by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/commit/3e6d2080a9905b5cc55f4b1515450544e761ded7

### Other

- Switch package manager from yarn to pnpm by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/680
- Harden CI security by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/679

**Full Changelog**: [`v3.6.0...v3.7.0`](https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/compare/v3.6.0...tailwind-merge@3.7.0)
